# Calogero Sanfilippo

> Personal website of Calogero Sanfilippo, a software engineer from Italy working as a Software Architect at Gucci. Outside of work he builds open source libraries in Swift and Kotlin and ships small iOS apps.

## About

- [About](https://calogerosanfilippo.it/about/): Background and bio.
- [CV](https://calogerosanfilippo.it/cv.pdf): Resume as PDF.

## Libraries

- [aral](https://calogerosanfilippo.it/libs/aral/): A Kotlin Multiplatform XML push parser with a lightweight, event-driven design.
- [altai](https://calogerosanfilippo.it/libs/altai/): A Swift package that makes typed throws practical by uplifting nested errors into your domain error type.
- [swift-sgp4](https://calogerosanfilippo.it/libs/swift-spg4/): A Swift package for satellite orbit prediction from TLE (two-line element) data.

## Mobile apps

- [CardStore](https://calogerosanfilippo.it/apps/cardstore/): Free iOS app that keeps loyalty, membership, and store cards in one place.
- [ISSSeeker](https://calogerosanfilippo.it/apps/issseeker/): Free iOS app that tracks the International Space Station's real-time position.
- [TurinPark](https://calogerosanfilippo.it/apps/turinpark/): iOS app that shows real-time available parking spaces in Turin.
- [WorldSpinner](https://calogerosanfilippo.it/apps/worldspinner/): iOS app that suggests random travel destinations with a phone shake (no longer available on the App Store).

## Tools

- [oman-petrol-stations](https://calogerosanfilippo.it/tools/oman-petrol-stations/): Swift CLI that fetches petrol station data from the three major chains in Oman and exports it as CSV or KML.

## Posts

- [Blog index](https://calogerosanfilippo.it/posts/): Release notes and updates for the libraries, apps, and tools above.
